description: Vendor-documented size caps on always-loaded guidance, per harness. scope per-file-after-includes caps each projected always-on file after its includes are expanded; combined-chain caps everything a harness loads at startup together. cap_bytes is null when the vendor documents no byte cap; source_url is then the page checked. Never estimate a number. Read by test/guards/guidance-caps.test.ts (G74). agent_description_caps (row 131) is the same record for the combined name and description text of the shared agent specs, in tokens estimated at 4 characters each; agent_description_ratchet is a growth ceiling, not a vendor cap, that applies where no vendor documents one. Read by test/guards/skill-structure.test.ts (G75).

caps.note: 4 MiB per CLAUDE.md file loaded at launch; a larger file is skipped entirely. The page's 200-line target is advice, not a cap.
project_doc_max_bytes, 32 KiB by default: Codex stops adding AGENTS.md files once the combined size reaches it.
No cap documented; the context-file loader reads each file whole.
No cap documented for the CLI. A 4,000-character limit for code review only is cited secondhand and is not in the current docs.
No size cap documented for steering files.
Antigravity truncates any single rule file over 24,000 bytes after expanding @[label](path) includes.
All active global and always_on rules share a 20,000-token budget; over it the largest are demoted to pointers. Tokens, not bytes, so no byte cap is recorded.

agent_description_caps.note: When the combined descriptions of the subagents, built-in ones excepted, pass 15,000 tokens, Claude Code warns at startup and still loads every subagent. Each agent counts its name plus its description.
No description cap documented; the only cap is agents.max_concurrent_threads_per_session, a thread count.
No cap documented; the page asks for a brief description.
Pi has no subagent surface (its README says it skips sub-agents), so nothing lists agent descriptions.
No description cap documented; the agent prompt body is capped at 30,000 characters.

agent_description_ratchet.note: RATCHET, NOT A VENDOR CAP. The combined name and description characters of core/shared/agent-specs/*.md, measured at row 131. It holds the harnesses whose vendor documents no cap to the current size: raise it in its own commit with the new measurement when an added or longer description is deliberate.
